svg.title: STT Streaming Audio Processing & Inference Execution Lifecycle
svg.desc: Microphone Ingress → Redis Audio Stream → IngestionConsumer → DSP & Silero VAD → Whisper ASR Decoder → RepeatGuard & Lexicon → Result Egress

g.text: Phase 1: Real-Time Audio Capture & Redis Ingestion
Phase 2: Polyphase DSP, Silero VAD & Utterance Segmentation
Phase 3: GPU ASR Decoding, Guard Post-Processing & Result Egress
